import asyncio
from fastmcp import Server, Client

async def main():
    # Create server and register a resource
    server = Server("config-server")
    
    @server.resource("data://config")
    def get_config():
        return "Configuration data from the resource"
    
    # Create in-memory client connected directly to the server
    client = Client(server)
    
    # Fetch the resource
    resource = await client.read_resource("data://config")
    
    print(resource)

asyncio.run(main())
